corrections.proposed: remove (no height given in any source)
corrections.why: The only size in the sources is a standard 14-foot square building (USGS 1950), which is a floor dimension, not a height. The 4.3 m figure appears to be 14 feet converted.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Willhite says lightning destroyed the cupola in 1922 and a new structure went up that year; FFLOS and Firelookout.com say destroyed by lightning and rebuilt in 1927. The story reports both.
FFLOS says permanently removed in 1965; Firelookout.com and Willhite say destroyed permanently in 1965. The story says the sources differ.
Firelookout.com says about 13 miles southeast of Darrington; the 1950 survey description says about 16 miles airline southeast. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Brief height_m 4.3 looks like 14 feet converted from the USGS square-building size; proposed for removal. The 1922 versus 1927 rebuild and the removed versus destroyed 1965 fate are unresolved between sources. Willhite's page also describes a 1931 death of a former lookout; left out of the story as not needed. Lookout names are limited to the first lookout. Access 'public' is inferred from the hike description; no closure found. No WebSearch used; no source describes current remains of the cabin, and the 1950 survey station's survival is unknown. The 13 versus 16 mile distance from Darrington is reported in the story.
